```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(raster)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpattern)
library(ggsci)
library(ggh4x)
library(patchwork)

```

only need to do this once
```{r loading data}
path <- "D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/wy-aggregated domain/" #change here for dataset
tmp <- readRDS(paste(path,"all_vars-water-ag.RData",sep="")) #change here for name
sd.df <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 452*64,ncol = 10))
names(sd.df) <- c("Year","band","DroughtType","Elev","SnowType","Y_Axis","X_Axis","P","PET","Expected_Raw")
count = 1

for (i in 1:length(tmp)){
  tmp2 <- tmp[[i]]
  tmp3 <- tmp2 %>% group_by(Year,band,DroughtType,Elev,SnowType) %>%
    summarize_all(mean,na.rm=TRUE) %>% data.frame()
  
  sd.df[(count:(count+nrow(tmp3)-1)),1:10] <- tmp3
  
  count = count+nrow(tmp3)
  print(i)
}

# sd.df <- as.data.frame(rbindlist(tmp))
sd.df <- sd.df %>% filter(SnowType < 7) %>% na.omit() #removing 7 (Ice) and 8 (NA--I think as of now, will validate later 7/2/24)

sd.df$exp <- ((1-exp(-sd.df$X_Axis))*sd.df$X_Axis*tanh(sd.df$P/sd.df$PET))^0.5

sd.df$anom <- sd.df$exp - sd.df$Y_Axis
#this doesnt make as much sense as the other calculation and it also is producing results that doesnt
#match up with the global maps, so sticking with the anom post-loop calculation
# sd.df$anom2 <- sd.df$Expected_Raw - sd.df$Y_Axis #this is calculated from the in-loop expected equation 

sd.df$ID <- "Water Year" #change here for the data aggregation
write.csv(sd.df,paste(path,"all_vars-structured.csv",sep=""))

```

```{r loading data}
# wy <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/wy-aggregated domain/all_vars-structured.csv")
cold <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/winter-aggregated domain/all_vars-structured.csv")

# sd.df <- rbind(wy,cold)

#if just doing one
sd.df <- cold #CHANGE HERE--THIS IS FOR THE WY AND CHANGING TO SHOW JENNY

sd.df$DroughtType <- factor(sd.df$DroughtType, levels = c("1", "2", "3","4"),
                            labels = c("Dry",
                                       "NoDrought",
                                       "Warm",
                                       "WarmDry"))
sd.df$DroughtType <- factor(sd.df$DroughtType, levels=c('Dry', 'Warm', 'WarmDry', 'NoDrought'))

sd.df$SnowType <- factor(sd.df$SnowType, levels = c("1","2","3","4","5","6"),
                         labels = c("Tundra",
                                    "Boreal\nForest",
                                    "Maritime",
                                    "Ephemeral",
                                    "Prairie",
                                    "Montane\nForest"))

sd.df <- sd.df %>% filter(Elev !=">5000m") #if not using >5000m
sd.df$Elev <- factor(sd.df$Elev, levels=c('0-1000m', '1001-2000m', '2001-3000m', '3001-4000m','4001-5000m'))

# sd.df$Elev <- factor(sd.df$Elev, levels=c('0-1000m', '1001-2000m', '2001-3000m', '3001-4000m','4001-5000m','>5000m'))

```

```{r plotting as paired boxplots}

path <- "D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/"

sd_dry <- sd.df %>% filter(DroughtType == "Dry" | DroughtType == "NoDrought") %>% filter(band < 70)
sd_dry$Drought <- ifelse(sd_dry$DroughtType == "Dry", "Drought","No\nDrought")
sd_dry2 <- sd_dry %>% dplyr::select(band,Drought,Elev,SnowType,anom) %>% filter(Elev !=">5000") %>% as.data.frame()

sd_warm <- sd.df %>% filter(DroughtType == "Warm" | DroughtType == "NoDrought")%>% filter(band < 70)
sd_warm$Drought <- ifelse(sd_warm$DroughtType == "Warm", "Drought","No\nDrought")
sd_warm2 <- sd_warm %>% dplyr::select(band,Drought,Elev,SnowType,anom) %>% filter(Elev !=">5000") %>% as.data.frame()

sd_wd <- sd.df %>% filter(DroughtType == "WarmDry" | DroughtType == "NoDrought")%>% filter(band < 70)
sd_wd$Drought <- ifelse(sd_wd$DroughtType == "WarmDry", "Drought","No\nDrought")
sd_wd2 <- sd_wd %>% dplyr::select(band,Drought,Elev,SnowType,anom) %>% filter(Elev !=">5000") %>% as.data.frame()

sd_dry2$band <- factor(sd_dry2$band, levels=c('60', '50', '40', '30','20'))
sd_dry2$Drought <- factor(sd_dry2$Drought, levels=c('No\nDrought',"Drought"))

sd_warm2$band <- factor(sd_warm2$band, levels=c('60', '50', '40', '30','20'))
sd_warm2$Drought <- factor(sd_warm2$Drought, levels=c('No\nDrought',"Drought"))

sd_wd2$band <- factor(sd_wd2$band, levels=c('60', '50', '40', '30','20'))
sd_wd2$Drought <- factor(sd_wd2$Drought, levels=c('No\nDrought',"Drought"))

tmp1 <- sd_dry2 %>% group_by(band,Drought,Elev,SnowType) %>% count() %>% as.data.frame()
points_dry <- tmp1 %>% filter(n < 10)
points_dry2 <- merge(sd_dry2,points_dry,by = c("band","Drought","Elev","SnowType"))

dry_col_plot <- ggplot(sd_dry2,aes(x = Elev,y=anom,fill=Elev,alpha=Drought,color=Elev,
                                   group = interaction(Elev, Drought))) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75,preserve = "single"),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1,0.7))+
  geom_point(data = points_dry2, aes(x = Elev,y=anom,color=Elev,alpha = Drought,
                                    group = interaction(Elev, Drought)))+
  facet_grid(band~SnowType,scale="free",drop=FALSE)+
  stat_summary(aes(group = interaction(Elev, Drought)),
               fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.35,
               linewidth = 0.25,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75, preserve = "single"),
               color = "black") +
  scale_fill_npg()+
  scale_color_npg()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(title="Dry",y="Budyko Anomaly",fill="Elevation",x="") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "NULL",
        strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,5,0,1), "mm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))

png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/dry-cold0129.png",width=8,height=4,units="in",res=2000)
print(dry_col_plot)
dev.off()

tmp2 <- sd_warm2 %>% group_by(band,Drought,Elev,SnowType) %>% count() %>% as.data.frame()
points_warm <- tmp2 %>% filter(n < 10)
points_warm2 <- merge(sd_warm2,points_warm,by = c("band","Drought","Elev","SnowType"))

warm_col_plot <- ggplot(sd_warm2,aes(x = Elev,y=anom,fill=Elev,alpha=Drought,color=Elev,

                                    group = interaction(Elev, Drought)))+
  facet_grid(band~SnowType,scale="free",drop=FALSE)+
  stat_summary(aes(group = interaction(Elev, Drought)),
               fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.35,
               linewidth = 0.25,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75, preserve = "single"),
               color = "black") +
  scale_fill_npg()+
  scale_color_npg()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(title="Warm",y="Budyko Anomaly",fill="Elevation",x="") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,5,0,1), "mm"),
        legend.position = "NULL",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))


png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/warm-cold0129.png",width=8,height=4,units="in",res=2000)
print(warm_col_plot)
dev.off()

tmp3 <- sd_wd2 %>% group_by(band,Drought,Elev,SnowType) %>% count() %>% as.data.frame()
points_wd <- tmp3 %>% filter(n < 10)
```

```{r for the legend}
legend_plot <- ggplot(sd_wd2,aes(x = Elev,y=anom,fill=Elev,alpha=Drought,color=Elev,
                                   group = interaction(Elev, Drought))) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75,preserve = "single"),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1,0.7), guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = c("black","grey"))))+
  facet_grid(band~SnowType,scale="free",drop=FALSE)+
  stat_summary(aes(group = interaction(Elev, Drought)),
               fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.35,
               linewidth = 0.25,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75, preserve = "single"),
               color = "black") +
  scale_fill_npg()+
  scale_color_npg(guide = "none")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(title="",y="Budyko Anomaly",fill="Elevation",x="") +
  theme_void()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,5,0,1), "mm"),
        legend.margin=margin(c(0,0,1,0)))

library(cowplot)

# Extract the legend
leg <- get_legend(legend_plot)

# Plot the legend alone
plot_grid(leg)
png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/Budyko/legend0122.png",width=9,height=4,units="in",res=2000)
print(plot_grid(leg))
dev.off()


```
